title: Lemony Pea and Pistachio Pesto Pasta Salad
changes_from_base: A pea, ricotta and pistachio pesto with lemon and mint replaces the oregano vinaigrette, mozzarella and olives.
summary: Penne in a creamy, bright green pesto of peas, ricotta and pistachios with lemon zest, then finished with fresh mint and more pistachios.

ingredients.item: fine salt for 4 litres of pasta water (1%)
ingredients.note: about 6.75 tsp; most of it goes down the drain

steps.title: Cook the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta in the salted water until just past al dente. Scoop out 120 ml of the water, then drain, rinse cold and shake dry.

steps.title: Blend the pesto
steps.text: Blend half the peas with the ricotta, pistachios, cheese, garlic, lemon zest and juice, oil, pepper and 60 ml of the pasta water until smooth.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Toss the pasta with the pesto and remaining whole peas, loosening with more pasta water if thick.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scatter with mint and chopped pistachios and serve at room temperature.

tips: Save the pasta water before draining; its starch helps the pesto cling.
Thawed frozen peas give the sweetest, greenest pesto.
Serve at room temperature for the best flavour.
storage: Keeps covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; loosen with a splash of water or oil and check the seasoning before serving. Not suitable for freezing. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
